as_of_policy_description: Prediction-row as_of is the latest source-backed pre-match timestamp the replayed prediction is allowed to depend on. Because the historical source exposes fixture date plus kickoff time but no finer observation timestamp for the football-process inputs used here, persist as_of as the fixture kickoff timestamp when kickoff_time is present, otherwise the conservative day-start timestamp match_dateT00:00:00. This preserves the rule that historical pre-match as_of never exceeds kickoff.
